title: OLAP for Software Engineers
description: A software-engineering-first approach to data engineering on top of the base infrastructure. MooseStack provides typed schemas, automated migrations, built-in MCP server, and hot-reloading dev environment. The agent works within a unified framework instead of wiring independent tools.
installScript: bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) 514@0.64.0 && ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/514" /usr/local/bin/514 && bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) moose@0.6.518 && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.moose/bin:$PATH" && ln -sf "$HOME/.moose/bin/moose" /usr/local/bin/moose && TEMPLATE_PROBE_DIR=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TEMPLATE_PROBE_DIR" && moose init __probe typescript-empty >/dev/null 2>&1 && TEMPLATE_LIB=$(node -e "console.log(require('./__probe/package.json').dependencies['@514labs/moose-lib'])" 2>/dev/null) && echo "Template pins moose-lib@${TEMPLATE_LIB}" && if [ -n "$TEMPLATE_LIB" ] && [ "$TEMPLATE_LIB" != "0.6.518" ]; then echo "Pre-caching moose CLI ${TEMPLATE_LIB} to match template" && bash -i <(curl -fsSL https://fiveonefour.com/install.sh) moose@${TEMPLATE_LIB}; fi && rm -rf "$TEMPLATE_PROBE_DIR" && cd / && mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" && if 514 agent init --agent claude-code --yes; then true; else node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const home=process.env.HOME; const configPath=`${home}/.claude.json`; fs.mkdirSync(`${home}/.claude/skills`, { recursive: true }); let root={}; try { root=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, "utf8")); } catch (error) { root={}; } root.mcpServers={...(root.mcpServers||{}), "moose-dev": { type: "http", url: "http://localhost:4000/mcp" }, "context7": { type: "http", url: "https://mcp.context7.com/mcp" }}; fs.writeFileSync(configPath, `${JSON.stringify(root, null, 2)}\n`);'; fi && mkdir -p /opt/dec-bench/moose && cd /opt/dec-bench/moose && npm init -y && npm install @514labs/moose-lib@0.6.518 && CH_VER=25.8.18.1 && CH_VER_LTS=${CH_VER}-lts && ARCH=$(uname -m) && if [ "$ARCH" = "aarch64" ]; then CH_ARCH=arm64; PLAT=linux-aarch64; elif [ "$ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then CH_ARCH=amd64; PLAT=linux-x86_64; fi && CH_CACHE="$HOME/.moose/binaries/clickhouse/${CH_VER_LTS}/${PLAT}" && mkdir -p "$CH_CACHE" && curl -fSL "https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/releases/download/v${CH_VER_LTS}/clickhouse-common-static-${CH_VER}-${CH_ARCH}.tgz" | tar xz -C "$CH_CACHE" && chmod +x "${CH_CACHE}/clickhouse-common-static-${CH_VER}/usr/bin/clickhouse" && echo "Pre-cached ClickHouse ${CH_VER_LTS} for moose dev --dockerless"
